name: smwmusic-crystal-castle
title: Crystal Castle
description:
Today's Crystal Castle is brought to you by... a soundset mostly adapted from MTV Music Generator 2 for the PS2 (though not all of them come from here). Yes, the main priority is a castle theme, though perhaps it has a few other possible uses.

The song in question is a remix of a segment from part 1 of Journey of the Super Musician, a NES song that I submitted through Battle of the Bits, if you may have heard of this before.

Contains two user defines: one of them enables all of the panning commands (without them, the song is in mono), and one of them enables a surround effect. The latter also requires panning to be enabled in order to be used.
